summary: Frontend E2E validation of ADMIN Cancel Booking feature. Full flow executed successfully via UI: sell CVF plot 32 → record 1500000 payment → cancel with refund 1000000 → balance retained 500000. All data-testids present and working. Cancel button visible for admin ONLY on sold plots (not on available), Sell hidden while sold, edit-plot pencil visible for admin on available plots. CancelDialog cancel-summary live-updates (Amount paid 15,00,000 → Refunded 10,00,000 → Balance retained 5,00,000). Plot reverts to Available after cancel; Sell button reappears; buyer cleared. Sales & Payments head-cancellations tab (cancellations-view) shows summary cards (Cancellations=1, Total Refunded 10L, Balance Retained 5L) and cancel-row-32 with all required columns (Date, Plot 32, Buyer 'TEST Buyer Cancel', Paid 15L, Refunded 10L, Balance retained 5L, By Debabrata). AdminDashboard CVF card shows Total Sold ₹0, Total Received ₹5,00,000, Total Pending ₹0 — retained balance correctly folded into received. Post-test DB cleanup performed: units sold=0, payments=0, cancellations=0, sale_recorded/payment_received/booking_cancelled notifications=0.
critical_code_review_comments: SellDialog initial schedule already contains 1 empty row; s-add-row appends a second empty row. If a tester/user clicks 'Add instalment' before filling row 0 they get a confusing 'Each row needs an amount and a due date' error because row 1 is empty. Minor UX nit — consider only adding a row if the previous row has content, or clearly label the initial row.

cancel-date defaults to today (correct) but Cancellation record persists date literally; ensure timezone consistency between frontend Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) and backend ISO parse — verified working here.
seed_data_creation: Sold CVF plot 32 to 'TEST Buyer Cancel', recorded 1500000 payment, cancelled with 1000000 refund. All test data reverted after test: units sold=0, payments=0, cancellations=0, related notifications deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'Admin Cancel Booking' fully verified E2E via UI. Preview DB left pre-launch clean. If further changes touch Units.jsx SellDialog, note that initial schedule state = [{empty row}] so tests should NOT click s-add-row for a single instalment.
